description: Find US listed ETFs by ticker, fund name or a word from the name; etf_profile then takes the ticker. A former ticker answers with the fund it trades as now, a closed fund with its page and closing day. Funds filed but not trading come back in filed, never as results. Refuses rather than returning a near match.

desk.description: Optional: only funds on this desk, such as income or leverage.

query.description: A ticker, a fund name or a word from the name, case-insensitive, such as JEPI or semiconductor.

name: etf_search

data.description: The answer; null on a refusal.

error.description: Refusal only: what is not published.
